headline: NTSB exonerates Tesla FSD in fatal Texas house crash — driver at fault, not autonomy system; findings confirm FSD disengaged seconds before impact as driver failed to respond; confirms pattern of driver-error misattribution to Tesla's AI stack; bullish for FSD regulatory narrative heading into Jul 22 Q2 earnings (Teslarati, Jul 16, 2026)

Tesla opens Q2 2026 earnings call Q&A portal ahead of July 22 report — shareholders pressing for robotaxi expansion milestones, first Optimus production unit count, Cybercab fleet targets and paid-ride revenue, unsupervised FSD point-to-point summon ETA, and whether Elon pay package milestones will be met before any merger/acquisition; options market still pricing 7.6% move either direction (Drive Tesla Canada / Benzinga, Jul 16, 2026)

IG International Q2 2026 earnings preview: LSEG consensus 7 strong buy, 17 buy, 24 hold, 6 sell — mean analyst PT $397.89; Q2 deliveries 480K a clear beat but analysts flagging lower ASPs, $25B capex cycle, and negative FCF risk as headwinds; key question is whether record deliveries translated to margin recovery above Q1's 21.1%; earnings July 22 after market close (IG International, Jul 16, 2026)

TSLA eyes weekly loss (-3% WTD) as retail investors grill Musk on missed robotaxi targets — top Say Technologies questions ahead of Jul 22 Q2 earnings: 'Why has Tesla missed short-term robotaxi guidance 3 earnings in a row?' and 'When will Cybercab start customer rides?'; investors demanding concrete fleet size, paid rides, intervention rates, cost per mile, and revenue contribution instead of broader progress updates; Koyfin projects Q2 revenue +17% YoY, adjusted EPS +31% YoY; TSLA -0.3% premarket Thursday after closing at $394.46 (-0.43%) Wednesday as pre-earnings positioning weighs on stock (Stocktwits / Yahoo Finance, Jul 16, 2026)

Tesla Q2 2026 earnings preview: TipRanks consensus EPS $0.52-0.55 (+30-38% YoY), revenue $25.81B (+14.8% YoY); top investor questions are unsupervised FSD point-to-point summon timeline, when Cybercab will start public customer rides, first Optimus production unit count, and automotive gross margin vs Q1's 21.1% — 7 analysts revised Q2 estimates higher since Jul 13; earnings July 22 after market close (TipRanks / Benzinga, Jul 15-16, 2026)

FSD v14.3.5 new features confirmed (build 2026.20.6.6): blind spot warnings expanded to new Model Y, 2021+ Model S, and 2021+ Model X (previously Cybertruck/Highland Model 3 only); dashcam clip encryption added for all USB-stored footage and Sentry Mode files; camera preview accessible any time (not just during FSD); live FSD status in Tesla app; early testers report strong performance across complex real-world routes (notateslaapp / Teslarati, Jul 14-15, 2026)

FSD v14.3.5 third deployment wave pushes to ~1,210 additional AI4 vehicles July 15 — three rapid deployment waves of build 2026.20.6.6 in quick succession; aggressive rollout cadence signals Tesla building confidence in v14.3.5 branch ahead of July 22 Q2 earnings; FSD v14 Lite (HW3) still at <0.1% of legacy fleet per TeslaFi/Tessie tracking — millions of HW3 owners waiting; staged validation approach before broad fleet deployment to full HW4 fleet (basenor / TeslaOracle, Jul 14-15, 2026)

Wells Fargo raises TSLA PT to $130 from $125, still implies 67% downside — analyst Colin Langan lifted price target on July 14 but maintained Underweight; at ~$394 current price, $130 target implies ~67% decline; bear case: stock prices in a future Tesla has not yet delivered, negative FCF, and $25B capex cycle with uncertain payback; joins JPMorgan and GLJ Research as structural bears heading into July 22 Q2 earnings; LSEG mean consensus PT $397.89 (IG) vs $402.69 (TipRanks) across ~29-55 analysts, reflecting historically wide $130–$650 spread (Wells Fargo / Yahoo Finance, Jul 14-15, 2026)

Tesla Q2 2026 energy deployment: 13.5 GWh (+53% QoQ) — record Q2 in company history, confirms Q1 8.8 GWh miss was timing not demand — at Q2 run-rate Tesla tracking toward ~54 GWh full-year 2026 vs ~48 GWh consensus; energy gross margins to be revealed Jul 22; energy recovery removes key bear narrative from Q1 and directly supports $10B+ energy revenue thesis for full-year 2026 (teslaoracle.com / Tesla IR, Jul 15, 2026)

Tesla Robotaxi fleet near-flawless in new NHTSA safety report (Apr 15–Jun 16) — Tesla logged only 1 incident in 62 days of unsupervised Austin operation: a zero-fault event where a stationary Robotaxi obeying a red arrow signal was rear-ended by a human-driven pickup truck; Zoox logged +6 incidents, Waymo +191 in the same period; strongest safety data point yet heading into Jul 22 Q2 earnings (notateslaapp / NHTSA filings, Jul 13, 2026)
